name: plate greaves
_design_note: F50-100 heavy legs slot. Full plate cuisse, poleyn, greave from hip to ankle. Pairs with plate/full plate body. Lighter than legacy 6 lb spec — the existing 6 lb assumed lower-quality articulation; modern entry assumes the engineered hinge that justifies a real plate suit.
lore_template: Armorers were a century in learning how three {material_name} pieces may bend with a leg and never bind. In this harness the cuisse covers the thigh, the poleyn the knee and the fluted greave the shin down to the ankle, and there is a reason for every flute.
